title: Pet state v1
description: Read-only agent activity snapshot Lynk (the Monitor) writes for a Pet/user-renderer to display. Contains only bounded, display-safe fields: no prompts, tokens, full event payloads, or arbitrary environment.

version.description: Semantic version of this contract payload.

producer.description: Identifier of the process that produced this envelope, e.g. "lynk-monitor".

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing counter for the producer's process lifetime. A renderer can use this to detect and ignore stale reads.

agents.description: One entry per Frontdoor root or Worker session currently known to the Monitor.

id.description: Stable identifier for this agent. Unique across the whole snapshot.

parentId.description: The id of the Frontdoor root this Worker was delegated from. Null for a Frontdoor root itself.

engine.description: Model or engine label backing this agent.

task.description: Bounded, display-safe description of the current task. Never a full prompt or event payload.
